review: QA Bot independent code review — momentum_rebalance.py (Momentum-HHHGDTJ daily rebalance planner)
scope_note: Read-only. No prepare/place/close calls. Only eToro calls: one read-semantics what-if costs preview (action=close, P position) on the keys book via execute-read. Probes ran in /tmp/qa_reb with MOMENTUM_AUDIT_DIR=/tmp/qa_reb/audit (no production audit rows or place_qa packs written).

reproduction.result: REPRODUCED with --dryrun-eval-in-ban and max_quote_age_s relaxed: 0 proposed, 21 rejected/blocked, TRIM P COST_GATE_FAIL (benefit $0 vs cost $1.658), FCX DEPLOY BLOCKED INTRADAY_BAN, edge_used 0.0 (n=18, mean net -3.35%, win 5.6%).
reproduction.fresh_rerun_without_flag: At 17:25 IL the same inputs give 16 rows: PM returns a single PM_SKIP INTRADAY_BAN (no risk evaluation at all) and TRIM P becomes STALE_QUOTE (quotes 124s old). That is correct fail-closed behavior for quotes. Running in-ban without the flag shows that PM exits are suppressed (see RISK_EXIT_GATED_BY_BAN).
reproduction.sensitivity_file: prior-only (prior_weight 1e6) gives edge_used 0.5%, so a $1000 buy has $5 benefit vs about $3.3 cost: still COST_GATE_FAIL under the 2x margin. Consistent.

fail_codes.evidence: plan() calls position_manager.manage(), which returns only SKIP/INTRADAY_BAN inside 16:30-18:30 and SKIP when NYSE is closed. Pack mode in the ban therefore cannot emit LOSS_PCT_GE_4 / <SMA50 closes. This contradicts the design ('Closes are always allowed') and spec MUST 6. The monkeypatch is only allowed in dry-run. Note: a protective close whose quote is missing or stale is still PROPOSED (correct, ungated), and its size is bounded to the full held units (correct).

Probe J: a PM CLOSE row for a symbol not on the keys book raises KeyError, and the whole run crashes, which also drops every valid protective close in the same run. Short positions are silently dropped (held = direction=='long'), so they are never risk-managed and never flagged.

Probe H: missing availableCash causes a KeyError crash. H2: availableCash=1e7 is accepted. G: a keys summary 9 months old is accepted (spec MUST 1 requires <=15 min, not implemented). Positions timestamp, mirror timestamp and screener-run date (the 10-09 regime was used on 10-12) are not checked. _load() returns None for non-JSON and silently slices wrapper text. Config overrides are unvalidated (probe N: prior 20%, haircut 1, cap 50% gives a PROPOSED buy). min_order_usd is defined but never enforced.
Probe F: a quote with asOf 1 day in the future has negative age, passes the 60s check, and the buy is PROPOSED. Age must be abs() or rejected if <0 / future skew > 5s.

Probe A: 4 MOMENTUM_BREAKOUT rows with RVOL 0.5 and week -3% (DWM red) give 3 PROPOSED buys (the 4th was stopped only by cash). Not enforced: max 2 breakouts per pack night, RVOL>=2.0 (2.5 soft), DWM>=0, RS>=90. Probe O: screener leverage=5 / direction=sell are ignored rather than rejected (the planner hard-codes x1 buy, but a bad row should FAIL, not be silently rewritten). Probe Q2: QQQ/SPY labeled STOCK bypass the 1-ETF rule (the ETF set is a hard-coded list).

Probe D: stop_loss=None gives a PROPOSED buy with stopLossRate null. Probe P: a stop at 150 on a $100 instrument (above price) is PROPOSED. The stop is copied verbatim from the screener row and is never validated against the live ask/bid or entry (must be 0 < SL < bid, within a max risk %).

Benefit = notional x edge_used only. There is no per-trade downside term (risk to stop = amount x (entry-SL)/entry x p_loss) and no use of per-name SL distance. Today this is masked because the empirical edge is negative (edge_used=0), but a prior-heavy or config-overridden edge can pass with no loss leg.

The design claims the costs route rejects 'close'. That is false. The eToro API docs state that for action: close, positionIds must be non-empty, and a live read-semantics what-if call (keys, P position 3587299961, action=close, 14:24:55Z = 17:24:55 IL) returned 200 with transactionFee $1.89, markup $0, marketSpread $2.77. The hard-coded fee_close_usd=1.50 understates the close fee by 26% for P. history_extra_fee_usd=$3 (open $1.50 + close $1.50) is also unverified: actual open+close for P-like names is about $3.39+. Open fee $1.50 (FCX) VERIFIED. Overnight $0 VERIFIED for the FCX x1 open only. FX 0 and tax are unverified (tax is configurable and off).

The pack carries no pack_sha256, input hashes, or snapshot fingerprints. Nothing in the code or execution path verifies a QA verdict (checker identity = QA Bot, skill, verdict age, pack hash match, run_id match). authorize_place=false is hard-coded in the planner, but the downstream place step trusts any file claiming PASS. The planner does not provide a verify_qa_verdict().
The keys cash re-read before each place exists only as text in execution_rules. No code path or helper enforces it, and keys cash age is not validated. Mirror A cash correctly never authorizes.

No file lock, no per-day or per-snapshot run key, and no check for existing packs or place_ack. Two runs (cron + manual) emit two independent packs for the same buys. Probe M: a duplicated screener row for the same symbol gives 2 PROPOSED DEPLOY_CASH buys of $1000 each (no candidate dedupe), which is a duplicate-buy / $2000-per-name breach.

The $1000 cap is applied to order amount only. Duplicate candidates (probe M) and pending open orders are not aggregated into per-name exposure. Pending orders from get-my-positions-and-orders are ignored for both held_syms and cash.

Probe L: ROTATION_PAIR P->BK0 is PROPOSED (sell leg) before buy_eval runs, and the buy leg is then REJECTED NOT_ELIGIBLE. The result is an orphan discretionary sell, contradicting 'no orphan sells'. The same applies to cost/cash rejections inside buy_eval after the pair is recorded.
TRIM emits unitsToDeduct at 6 decimals computed from bid, without checking instrument min units / precision / minPositionExposure. Trims currently never pass (0 benefit), so this is latent dead code.

PROPOSED_CONDITIONAL rows are added to both rejected and actions (double-listed). Cash draw uses fee_open only (no spread/slippage on a market order). Conditional buys rely on proceeds_est from a sell computed with the $1.50 assumed close fee. Probe R cascade (2 of 5 at $3000) is otherwise correct.
No test file references momentum_rebalance.py. momentum_qa/test_validate.py and classic_rsi/test_cost_gate.py are unrelated.

passed_checks: Long-only x1 hard-coded in mcp_order_params; amount min(1000, row amount)
EVENT_VOL_FREEZE: 10-12 not frozen; 10-13 22:40 frozen (prior session, CPI 10-14); 10-14 frozen. Freeze blocks buys and rotations (probe E)
INTRADAY_BAN / HARD_HALT / NYSE_CLOSED / no-regime block buys
DUPLICATE_HOLD_BUY, ETF_SLOT_FILLED / MAX_1_NEW_ETF for labeled or listed ETFs, ETF_FLOOR_KEEP for the only sector ETF (XLK)
Keys cash drawn down in sequence; INSUFFICIENT_CASH rejection; Mirror A never authorizes
Rotation and trim legs credit 0 benefit; edge floored 0 / capped; 2x margin gate; negative amount and tiny amount gate-fail
Protective PM closes are not cost-gated and are proposed even with missing quote; close size = full held units (bounded)
fixes: 1. Decouple protective exits from the ban/holiday SKIP: evaluate CLOSE (<SMA50, LOSS_PCT_GE_4) in pack mode regardless of ban (queue as WAITING_FOR_MARKET if closed). Only BE/TRAIL/buys honor the ban.

2. Guard PM rows: skip and flag symbols not on the keys book (PM_SYMBOL_NOT_HELD) instead of crashing. Wrap each row in try/except so one bad row never drops other closes. Flag and risk-check short/unknown-direction positions.

3. Add a validate_inputs() that fails closed: require keys positions/summary/mirror timestamps <=15 min, screener_run date == the current NYSE session, 0 <= availableCash <= totalValue, required fields present, and a strict JSON load. Whitelist and bound config overrides (edge_cap<=2, haircut<=0.5, prior<=1, margin>=2, fee floors). Enforce min_order_usd.
4. Quote age: reject age<0 beyond a 5s skew (FUTURE_QUOTE_TS).

5. Enforce the playbook in the planner: <=2 MOMENTUM_BREAKOUT per pack, RVOL>=2.0 (2.5 SOFT), RS>=90, DWM>=0. Reject rows with leverage!=1, direction!=buy, or account!=real. Classify ETFs by instrument type from get-instruments-overview, not a hard-coded list.
6. Pin the stop: require 0 < stop_loss < live bid, max risk % from entry (e.g. <=8%), and re-derive it from the screener's 10d-low logic. Reject NO_STOP_LOSS / SL_ABOVE_PRICE.
7. Add the downside leg to EV: expected = p_win x reward - p_loss x (amount x SL distance) - costs, using the empirical win rate (5.6% today), or at minimum require edge > SL-risk-weighted breakeven.

8. Replace fee_close_usd with a live what-if costs call (action=close, positionIds) for every sell/trim/rotation leg (verified working: P $1.89). For future-close cost on buys, use max(open fee, observed close fees) and document it. Recompute history_extra_fee from actual open+close fees. Mark FX/tax ASSUMED in every row.

9. Emit pack_sha256 plus input-file sha256s and the snapshot timestamp. Add verify_qa_verdict(pack, verdict) for the place step: checker == QA Bot, skill == momentum-real-money-qa-gate, verdict age <= 15 min, pack_sha256 and run_id match, and per-action authorize_place. Reject anything else (PLACE_WITHOUT_QA_BOT_RECHECK).
10. Implement the live cash re-check as code (a pre-place helper that re-reads keys availableCash and re-quotes, re-runs the gate on the fresh quote, and aborts if cash < amount+fee+buffer).

11. Idempotency: take an fcntl lock per day, use run key = hash(session date + keys snapshot), refuse if an un-acked pack or place_ack for the same symbol/session exists, and dedupe screener candidates by symbol.
12. Apply the $1000 cap to aggregate per-name exposure (held invested + pending open orders + proposed). Include pending orders in held_syms and in cash.
13. Rotation atomicity: run buy-leg eligibility, quote, cost and cash checks before recording the pair. If the buy leg fails, record the pair as REJECTED and do not emit the sell.
14. Trim sizing: round unitsToDeduct to instrument precision and check min units / minPositionExposure. Otherwise reject TRIM_SIZE_NOT_EXECUTABLE.
15. Cascade: do not double-list PROPOSED_CONDITIONAL rows. Include spread/slippage in the cash 'need'. Base proceeds on the verified close fee.
16. Add pytest coverage for every probe above (A-S) plus the 10-13 CPI freeze, ban/holiday risk-exit, and dry-run reproduction.

probes.I_close_in_ban_if_pm_emits: PROPOSED (but real pm.manage emits only SKIP in ban -> FAIL)
